```{r libs, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)     # this gives you %>% 
library(caret)
library(randomForest)
library(class)
library(ggplot2)
```



```{r rf_setup}
# ---- Load the dataset ----
df <- readr::read_csv("/Users/ianbarbero/Downloads/Crash_Data_Cleaned_v3.xlsx")

# TEMP: create a fake target until the real one exists
set.seed(42)
df$Pedestrian_Involved <- sample(0:1, nrow(df), replace = TRUE)

# Convert all character columns to factors
df <- df %>% mutate(across(where(is.character), as.factor))
df$Pedestrian_Involved <- as.factor(df$Pedestrian_Involved)

#removing rows with NA 
df <- df %>% drop_na()
df$Pedestrian_Involved <- as.factor(df$Pedestrian_Involved)

# ---- Train/Test Split ----
set.seed(123)
idx <- createDataPartition(df$Pedestrian_Involved, p = 0.7, list = FALSE)
train_df <- df[idx, ]
test_df  <- df[-idx, ]

# ---- Random Forest Model ----
set.seed(123)
rf_model <- randomForest(
  Pedestrian_Involved ~ .,
  data = train_df,
  ntree = 500,
  mtry = sqrt(ncol(train_df) - 1),
  importance = TRUE
)

# ---- Predictions ----
rf_pred <- predict(rf_model, newdata = test_df)

# ---- Confusion Matrix ----
confusionMatrix(rf_pred, test_df$Pedestrian_Involved)

# ---- Variable Importance ----
varImpPlot(rf_model, main = "Random Forest Variable Importance")
```


```{r rf_summary}
# ---- Accuracy as a numeric value ----
rf_conf <- confusionMatrix(rf_pred, test_df$Pedestrian_Involved)
rf_accuracy <- rf_conf$overall["Accuracy"]
rf_accuracy

# ---- Extract variable importance scores ----
rf_imp <- importance(rf_model)
rf_imp_df <- data.frame(
  Variable = rownames(rf_imp),
  MeanDecreaseGini = rf_imp[, "MeanDecreaseGini"]
) %>%
  arrange(desc(MeanDecreaseGini))

# View top 15 most important predictors
head(rf_imp_df, 15)

# Optional: plot top variables using ggplot
library(ggplot2)
rf_imp_df %>%
  top_n(15, MeanDecreaseGini) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(Variable, MeanDecreaseGini), 
             y = MeanDecreaseGini)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Top 15 Most Important Variables (Random Forest)",
       x = "Variable", y = "Importance (Mean Decrease Gini)")
```
